title: 第17章 收服疯狗打手第18章 果真是扶不起的纨绔
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
lines: 青符脸色陡变。
干瘦的脸上掠过一抹骇人戾气。
洪烈浑身一紧，手中长刀锵啷一声，横在了青符的脖颈之间。
青符完全无视了洪烈的存在。
往日的圆滑褪去，整个人变得出奇的平静。
“陛下，奴才听不懂你的意思。”
秦然随意一笑。
“既然听不懂，那便算了。朕只是需要一条狗，至于是散养还是拴着，对朕来说没有区别。”
说完，便自顾自地往前走。
青符面色阴晴不定。
“陛下留步！！”
青符最终还是开口了。
秦然懒得回头，也懒得说话。
青符眼眸深邃，“陛下，你刚说的十年之期当真？”
“当然，云祖见证。”
“那奴才的血亲……”
“朕会用最好的条件供养他们，十年之后还你们一家团圆。”
青符犹豫半晌，干枯脸上忽然又露出了往日的谄笑。
“既然陛下许诺，那奴才便不客气了，宝库中的宝贝皆可挑选？”
“朕一言九鼎！”
“那奴才多谢陛下了！”青符嘿嘿笑着，“陛下真是好手段啊……”
秦然扭头，“你说什么？”
啪。
青符毫不犹豫一巴掌甩在了自己脸上。
“嘿嘿，奴才失言了，陛下恕罪。”
洪烈一脸懵地盯着二人。
虎眸中写满了不解之色。
秦然瞟了眼对方，“刚才看门看的不错，这里的东西随便挑，把身上的伤治好。”
“以后好好给朕看门。”
洪烈满脸不可思议。
秦然对洪烈这个名字有那么一点印象，加上他之前的表现，便隐约回忆到了此人的身份。
他应该是先帝身边的臣子之一，算是当今皇宫里为数不多的护帝一派。
这种人设不会背叛皇室，也不会背叛云家，秦然身边如今缺人用，正好将其拉拢到身边……
二人各自挑选去了。
秦然对灵石没兴趣，对武器装备也没想法，它径直来到了丹药区。
如今提升修为境界是重中之重，嗑药虽然有些副作用，但却是最快的方法。
丹药区中的丹药各式各样，解毒的，投毒的，破禁的，延年益寿的，各种效果应有尽有。
秦然在数量不多的金色光团中挑选到了两个。
【小造化丹（天阶低品）】
content_en:
Qing Fu's expression suddenly changed.
A look of terrifying anger flashed across his thin face.
Hong Lie tensed up, and with a clang of the long knife in his hand, he placed it between Qing Fu's neck.
"Stand back!!!"
Qing Fu completely ignored Hong Lie's existence.
The smoothness of the past faded away, and the whole person became surprisingly calm.
"Your Majesty, I don't understand what you mean."
Qin Ran smiled casually.
"Since you don't understand, forget it. I just need a dog. It makes no difference to me whether it's free-range or tethered."
After saying that, he walked forward on his own.
Qing Fu's face looked uncertain.
"Your Majesty, stay!!"
Qing Fu finally spoke.
Kieran was too lazy to look back or speak.
Qing Fu's eyes were deep, "Your Majesty, are you serious about the ten-year period you just mentioned?"
"Of course, Zu Yun will witness."
"That slave's blood relative..."
"I will support them with the best conditions and reunite your family in ten years."
Qing Fu hesitated for a long time, and suddenly his old flattering smile appeared on his dry face.
"Since His Majesty has promised, then you are welcome, slave. You can choose from all the treasures in the treasure house?"
"I keep my word!"
"Thank you so much, Your Majesty, slave!" Qing Fu chuckled, "Your Majesty is really good at it..."
Kieran turned his head, "What did you say?"
Snap.
Qing Fu slapped him in the face without hesitation.
"Hey, my servant made a mistake. Your Majesty, please forgive me."
Hong Lie stared at the two of them in confusion.
The tiger's eyes were filled with confusion.
Qin Ran glanced at the other party and said, "The gatekeeper did a good job just now. You can pick whatever you want here and heal your injuries."
"Look after the door for me from now on."
Hong Lie's face was full of disbelief.
Qin Ran had some impression of the name Hong Lie, and coupled with his previous performance, he vaguely recalled this person's identity.
He should be one of the courtiers around the late emperor, and one of the few emperor-protecting factions in the palace today.
This kind of personality will not betray the royal family, nor will it betray the Yun family. Qin Ran is short of people around him now, so it is just right to draw him to his side...
The two of them chose to go.
Qin Ran had no interest in spirit stones and had no idea about weapons and equipment. He went straight to the pill area.
Nowadays, improving one's cultivation level is a top priority. Although taking drugs has some side effects, it is the fastest way.
There are all kinds of elixirs in the elixir area, including detoxifying, poisoning, breaking taboos, prolonging life, and all kinds of effects.
Qin Ran selected two of the few golden light groups.
[Small Creation Pill (Low Grade Heavenly Grade)]
